title: IMSUB subtracts components in binary64, rejects mixed "i"/"j" suffixes with #VALUE!, and rejects empty text with #NUM!
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, IMSUB(inumber1, inumber2) parses both operands to 15 significant digits, rejects empty text "" with #NUM! (while treating a blank cell as 0) and mixed "i"/"j" suffixes with #VALUE!, subtracts (re1 - re2) + (im1 - im2)i in binary64, and formats with Excel's 15-digit complex formatter. All 1,216 full-bank IMSUB rows match.
basis: Measured in CalcFunc-Evidence cache/w111-extended-regenerated-20260929/answers-imsub.json.gz (Excel 16.0 build 20430) and Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (prefix_metadata row 133); 1,216/1,216 full-bank rows match.
